blocks.text: South Meadows homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

South Meadows, October 2026. Detached houses: 11 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 18% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 8 listed at month end and 6 sold in October, a sales ratio of 75%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 14 sold over 5 months against an average of 11.6 listed, about 4.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 18 sold over 5 months against an average of 12.6 listed, about 3.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 6 sold.

faq.q: Which public schools serve South Meadows?
faq.a: No public school building sits inside the sub-area; Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue is the public secondary school for Pitt Meadows, and for the sample address used (10932 Barnston View Road), the SD42 locator gives Davie Jones Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary — SD42 has no middle tier, and catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in South Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed with 2 sold in the month and 8 condos and townhomes listed with 6 sold in the month in South Meadows. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is South Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 18%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 75% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
